name: Aim Reflex
summary:
Aim Reflex is a VR aim training experience built for players who want to sharpen their reflexes and aiming precision across all virtual reality shooters. Step into a fast-paced environment where every millisecond matters. Equip a variety of weapons and test your skills against two distinct target types: humanoid training robots and reactive spheres. Each target is designed to challenge different aspects of your aim, from steady tracking to quick flick shots.
